I will put some chemical fertilizer on this maize plot, but not too much because money is always tight and the plot is small. I will also use some manure if I can gather enough, and I prefer improved seed because it gives better harvest when the rains are good here in Mbeya. I do not plan to irrigate, and I will not use pesticide on this plot unless there is a serious problem, which I do not expect now. Most of the work will be done by my household, though I may hire a few days for peak work.
